## Weeks

Workshop and online-session slides, published as each week runs.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

weeks = [
    {"n": 1, "topic": "Distributions and Summarising Data", "status": "live",
     "links": [
         ("Workshop slides", "week1-slides.html", False),
         ("Online session", "week1-online-slides.html", False),
         ("Reaction-time tool", "week1-tool.html", True),
     ]},
    {"n": 2, "topic": "Inference", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 3, "topic": "Relationships Between Variables", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 4, "topic": "Regression I — Fitting the Line", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 5, "topic": "Regression I — Model Problems & Inference", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 6, "topic": "Regression II — Multiple Regression", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 7, "note": "Curriculum Enrichment Week — no session"},
    {"n": 8, "topic": "Other Models (GLMs)", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 9, "topic": "Causal Analysis and Experiments", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 10, "topic": "Prediction", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 11, "topic": "Time Series", "status": "pending"},
    {"n": 12, "note": "Portfolio presentations — see Canvas"},
]

def week_card(w):
    # Built as a single line — Pandoc's raw-HTML-block passthrough is
    # unreliable across multi-line nested divs under `output: asis`.
    if "note" in w:
        return (f'<div class="week-card is-note">'
                 f'<span class="week-num">Week {w["n"]:02d}</span>'
                 f'<p class="note-text">{w["note"]}</p></div>')

    if w["status"] == "live":
        chip = '<span class="status-chip live"><span class="dot"></span>Live</span>'
        pills = "".join(
            f'<a class="pill{" tool" if tool else ""}" href="{href}">{label}</a>'
            for label, href, tool in w["links"]
        )
    else:
        chip = '<span class="status-chip pending"><span class="dot"></span>Coming soon</span>'
        pills = ('<span class="pill disabled">Workshop slides</span>'
                 '<span class="pill disabled">Online session</span>')

    return (f'<div class="week-card">'
             f'<div class="week-card-head">'
             f'<div><span class="week-num">Week {w["n"]:02d}</span>'
             f'<span class="week-topic">{w["topic"]}</span></div>{chip}</div>'
             f'<div class="pill-row">{pills}</div></div>')

print('<div class="week-grid">')
for w in weeks:
    print(week_card(w))
print('</div>')
```
